checks: Real .NET host and interactive Blazor page opened an existing vault and imported its enabled-plugin list without rewriting it.
Real DOM insertion/migration, cross-window node/event types, CSS, Moment previews, settings control ownership and SVG registry behavior pass in the actual renderer.
The native-shaped Markdown embed registry owns a real renderer/editor and persists an exact physical edit, rather than supplying an empty constructor seam.
Declarative settings reject held asynchronous validation without saving, persist a valid value physically, navigate nested pages and dispose owned renders.
An actual confirmation blocks duplicate actions and waits for its physical configuration write before closing.
Unchanged-plugin workflow: Linter delayed settings persist on owned disable.
Unchanged-plugin workflow: QuickAdd nested settings and physical persistence.
Unchanged-plugin workflow: Templater security consent and cancellation.
Unchanged-plugin workflow: Natural Language Dates owned protocol callback.
Unchanged-plugin workflow: Kanban board rendering and physical checkbox persistence.
Unchanged-plugin workflow: Configured restoration and owned disable cleanup.
inputEnvironment: Windows occlusion and renderer/timer background throttling disabled in disposable UI processes, including restarts; production launch is unchanged.
